# APEX API

APEX is a single-tenant / self-hosted content engine: it ingests raw posts from
sources (Telegram channels, RSS, YouTube, manual links/text), clusters them into
topics, runs an AI pipeline to synthesize drafts (Telegram/LinkedIn/Twitter
formats + translations + fact-check + optional image), and publishes them.

Base URL: this server's origin. All API routes below are prefixed `/api/v1`
unless noted otherwise. Responses are JSON unless noted.

## Auth

- Bearer JWT (Supabase-issued) in `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
- `GET /api/v1/auth/me` — current user profile.
- `POST /api/v1/auth/logout` — stateless; client discards the session.
- Multi-tenant: every resource is scoped to the caller's `org_id`, derived from
  the authenticated user. There is no cross-org access.
- Dev mode (`DEV_AUTH=true`, non-production only) bypasses Supabase and issues
  a fixed dev user/org — never enabled in production.

## Errors

JSON error body: `{"error": "<CODE>", "message": "<safe message>"}`.

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 400 | `ApexException` — validation / business-rule error |
| 401 | missing/invalid auth |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedException` — actor lacks the required role |
| 404 | `ResourceNotFoundException` — resource missing or outside caller's org |
| 429 | `AIQuotaExceededException` — org's daily AI budget exceeded |
| 503 | `AIRouterException` — all AI providers failed for a task |

## Resource groups

### Users & Org (`/api/v1/users`, `/api/v1/orgs`)
- `GET /users/` — list active users in the caller's org.
- `PATCH /users/me` — update own profile / `preferences` (JSON: default_language,
  content_tone, writing_style, default_length, notifications, ...).
- `GET|PATCH /orgs/current` — read/update the org (name, `settings` JSON).
- `GET /orgs/current/integrations`, `PUT /orgs/current/integrations` — org-level
  API keys/secrets (AI providers, Telegram/Twitter/LinkedIn/SMTP email, source parsing).
  Values are encrypted at rest; org value wins, falls back to server env var.
- `GET /orgs/current/users` — team roster (id, name, email, role, active, created).
- `PATCH /orgs/current/users/{user_id}` — body `{role?, is_active?}`, role one of
  `admin|editor|viewer`. Caller must have role `admin` (403 otherwise). A caller
  may not demote or deactivate their own account (400).
- `POST /orgs/current/notifications/test` — sends a real Telegram test message
  via the org's (or env-fallback) bot; `{"ok": true}` on success, 400 if no bot
  token/chat id is configured.

### Content (`/api/v1/content`)
- Sources: `GET|POST /sources`, `PUT|DELETE /sources/{id}`,
  `POST /sources/{id}/parse`, `POST /sources/parse-all`, `GET /sources/{id}/status`.
- Raw posts: `GET /raw-posts`, `GET|PATCH|DELETE /raw-posts/{id}`,
  `GET /raw-posts/{id}/related` (pgvector, tag-overlap fallback),
  `PATCH /raw-posts/{id}/tags` (body `{tags}`).
- Custom input: `POST /custom-input` (url | youtube | text).
- Clusters: `GET /clusters`, `GET /clusters/{id}`, `POST /clusters/refresh`,
  `POST /clusters/{id}/dismiss`, `POST /clusters/search` (body `{query, tags}`).
- Drafts: `GET|POST /drafts`, `GET /drafts/{id}`, `GET /drafts/{id}/status`,
  `PATCH|DELETE /drafts/{id}`, `GET /drafts/{id}/related`,
  `POST /drafts/{id}/publish` (body: platforms, languages, optional `scheduled_at`) — queues the
  publish pipeline (async), or with a future `scheduled_at` creates a calendar entry
  (`{"status":"scheduled"}`) that a beat task publishes when due. Platforms: telegram,
  twitter, linkedin, email. `POST /drafts/{id}/regenerate` (re-runs the pipeline),
  `GET /drafts/{id}/pdf?lang=`, `GET /drafts/{id}/pptx?lang=` (downloads),
  `GET /drafts/{id}/chart.png` (from `chart_data`, set via PATCH). `regenerate` body `{steps, languages}`
  re-runs only the chosen stages.
- Published: `GET /published`, `GET /published/{id}`,
  `POST /published/{id}/sync`, `POST /published/sync-all` (Twitter/X metrics only; other
  platforms are reported unsupported), `PATCH /published/{id}/tags`.
- Style / image-style presets: `GET|POST /style-presets`,
  `PUT|DELETE /style-presets/{id}`, `POST /style-presets/{id}/duplicate`,
  `GET /style-presets/{id}/versions`, `POST /style-presets/{id}/restore` (body `{version}`),
  `GET|POST /image-style-presets`, `PUT|DELETE /image-style-presets/{id}`.
- Tags: `GET|POST /tags`, `PUT|DELETE /tags/{id}`.
- Knowledge graph: `GET /graph`, `GET /graph/{id}` (node + neighbours), `POST /graph/links`, `DELETE /graph/links/{id}`.
- Auto-mode: `GET|PUT /auto-mode`, `POST /auto-mode/enable`,
  `POST /auto-mode/disable`, `GET /auto-mode/preview`, `GET /auto-mode/activity`
  (run history + 30-day stats).
- Calendar: `GET /calendar`, `PUT /calendar/{id}/reschedule`,
  `DELETE /calendar/{id}`.
- Recommendations: `GET /recommendations`, `POST /recommendations/refresh`.
- Dashboard / reporting: `GET /dashboard-stats`, `GET /my-activity`,
  `GET /ai-usage` — today/30d AI spend, by model, by task, plus
  `daily_limit_usd` / `daily_remaining_usd` (respects the org's
  `settings.ai_daily_limit_usd` override, else the server default).
- Export: `GET /export` (JSON download, `Content-Disposition: attachment`,
  filename `apex-export.json`) — org-scoped `{org, sources[], drafts[],
  published[], tags[], exported_at}`. Also reachable, unauthenticated-path
  aside, at the un-versioned alias `GET /api/content/export`.

## Notifications

Org-level Telegram notifications, toggled per event in
`org.settings.notifications` (`draft_ready`, `published`, `pipeline_failed`,
`budget_alert`; default on when unset). Sent via the org's Telegram bot token
+ chat id (falls back to server env vars). Delivery failures are logged and
never break the triggering pipeline/job. `budget_alert` fires at most once per
UTC calendar day, when daily AI spend reaches 80% of the org's daily budget.

## AI spend guard

Every AI call is metered (`ai_usage` table) and gated against the org's daily
budget (`org.settings.ai_daily_limit_usd`, falling back to the server's
`MAX_AI_COST_PER_DAY_USD`). Once the budget is reached the AI router raises a
429 (`AI_QUOTA_EXCEEDED`) instead of calling a paid model.

## Misc

- `GET /health` — liveness probe.
- `GET /llms.txt` — this document.
